title: 14 of 28 CMs face serious criminal cases, Supreme Court told

content: president Donald Trump met a teenage lifeguard and the boy he rescued off the California coast . the pair were honoured at a white house ceremony also attended by their families . "what you did was incredible, and everybody saw it," he told the duo .

title: ISI-backed ring busted, 253 operatives held across 14 states
